title: SSV Silver Gull — Ship Combat
description: Ship-combat systems for the SSV Silver Gull campaign. Full-screen Ship Overview (press S) with a crew-centric multiplayer turn/action tracker and per-station action consoles for all 15 stations. Directional ship AC (four facings = base + maneuver + shields) reads out around the hull and in a compact line; GMs set the base. Shields/Comms is fully built (Allocate Shields, Jam/Hail rolls, violet-arc Micro-Adjust); the Captain's Grant Actions gives a crew a purple-star extra action. Systems have HP (5 each; damaged systems stop working, 0 HP = destroyed); the Engineer repairs them by rolling d20+INT then solving a timed, system-themed puzzle mini-game (8 distinct puzzles). The Pilot drives the ship inline from the turn bar (pick a maneuver → Movement Points → move/rotate the ship token; action circle drains full→half→empty, bonus adds +1). Gunners work the same way: pick a gun (Light Flak Turret +5/2d6 or Heavy Autocannon +3/4d6) → a forward 90° firing-arc cone is drawn on the ship token on the map (green close band, red long band, scaled to the gun's range in grid squares, rotating with the ship) → Fire (optional Quick Aim +2 spending the bonus, roll or manual to-hit = gun + STR + bonuses, the GM confirms the hit, then a damage roll), Called Shot (target an enemy system; nat 20 = 2 damage, nat 1 = 1 to your own Weapons, else 1), or Boarding Fire (spends an action). Science's Navigation Support runs a nav mini-game (plot the course / thread the gates) whose score sets a x1.5-x2.5 multiplier on the Pilot's Movement Points, applied even mid-move. Movement burns fuel (rotate 45 = 1, rotate 90 = 2, forward = 4) and station actions draw power (shown as a ⚡ badge; e.g. fire 8, allocate shields 10, cloak 12) — convert fuel to power on the fly; the GM never spends fuel or power. A GM Proficiency editor adds a crew's proficiency bonus to named station rolls. A GM-only ⚙ GM Actions panel changes shields directly (no action cost) and announces to chat. Ship Inventory is a game-style grid (item pictures, search, ship/you tabs, hover detail popup) linked to the dnd5e ship actor: move items crew↔ship, FUEL/POWER gauges (baseline max 500), per-item fuel/power role+amount + an optional overcharge flag that pushes a gauge past its max (a running-hot buffer, shown with a glow), item rarity/tier badges, convert fuel→power (1→5 or 10→50), and GMs can add/edit/delete any item (searchable browser over all world items + item compendiums, or drag-drop).
